summary: Typosquat of tailwindcss-forms fetches and executes on-chain payload via Ethereum RPC on require
details: The package advertises itself as a Tailwind CSS forms plugin and copies the tailwindlabs/tailwindcss-forms README and repository metadata, but its main entry src/index.js contains no CSS or Tailwind logic. Instead, src/index.js is heavily obfuscated with an obfuscator.io string-array (`_0x18ab`, 303 entries) and imports node:http, node:https, node:zlib and child_process.spawn. On import it queries Ethereum indexers and public RPC endpoints (eth.blockscout.com, eth.drpc.org, ethereum-rpc.publicnode.com, 1rpc.io/eth, plus a caller-overridable ETH_RPC_URL) for transactions sent by a hardcoded sender EOA, reconstructs payload bytes from those transactions, and executes them via a freshly spawned node interpreter. Because the payload is delivered as Ethereum transactions written by an attacker-controlled address, the operator can push new code to every installer at any time without republishing to npm. The name mimics the legitimate tailwindcss-forms / @tailwindcss/forms package.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
